name: gradient-spin
title: Gradient Spin
description: A matrix loading spinner: a grid of cells swept by a gradient wavefront (arrow, diagonal, snake, ripple), with 8 gradient presets. One CSS keyframe, opacity only, no dependencies.
label: gradient-spin by Ziye Lu (BIAsia)
author: Ziye Lu (BIAsia) <https://github.com/BIAsia>

props.name: gradient
props.description: A preset, or stops `{ position: 0..1, color: hex }` (interpolated in OKLab).

props.name: cellSize / cellGap / cellRadius
props.description: Cell edge, gap and corner radius in pixels.

props.name: colorBy
props.description: Map the gradient top to bottom, or along the wave's travel order.

props.name: label
props.description: The status text screen readers announce.

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Freeze to a static 0.6 opacity under prefers-reduced-motion.

a11y: A status region (role="status") whose visually hidden content is the label (default "Loading"), so screen readers announce it (a Labs addition; upstream set only aria-label, which live regions do not announce).
Under prefers-reduced-motion the cells hold still at 0.6 opacity (respectReducedMotion, on by default).
In right-to-left pages the grid mirrors, so diagonal and snake waves run in the reading direction.
